feed.title: Greek News Aggregator — Daily Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories scraped from kathimerini.gr

entry.title: Το Ιράν διαβίβασε τους όρους για επανέναρξη διαπραγματεύσεων με τις ΗΠΑ
entry.summary: Iran conveyed to mediators its terms for resuming talks with the US aimed at ending the war. The conditions include a ceasefire on all fronts, the release of Iranian funds and lifting the naval blockade.

entry.title: Τουρκική υπερπτήση πάνω από τη Ρω – Drone και στη Ζουράφα
entry.summary: Turkish aircraft committed 13 air-traffic violations and seven national-airspace infringements over the Aegean, most by drones. Two overflights were recorded above the islets of Ro and Zourafa.

entry.title: Στουρνάρας: Πιθανή μια αύξηση των επιτοκίων από την ΕΚΤ τον Οκτώβριο
entry.summary: Bank of Greece Governor Yannis Stournaras said an ECB rate hike in October cannot be ruled out if inflation or energy costs spike. He called the absence of second-round wage effects 'good news' but not guaranteed.

entry.title: ΗΠΑ: Ο Τραμπ επικύρωσε το νέο πακέτο κυρώσεων κατά της Ρωσίας
entry.summary: Donald Trump signed a law imposing new sanctions on Russia, targeting for the first time its 'shadow fleet' and Putin himself. Named after the late Senator Lindsey Graham, it focuses mainly on the energy sector.

entry.title: Βριλήσσια: Στο νοσοκομείο 14χρονος μετά από επίθεση συμμαθητή του – Κινδυνεύει να χάσει το νεφρό του
entry.summary: A 14-year-old is hospitalized in serious condition after an attack by a classmate in Vrilissia, at risk of losing a kidney. Authorities arrested the assailant and his mother.

entry.title: Ισχυρό μήνυμα Ελλάδας – Κύπρου – Αιγύπτου
entry.summary: From the frigate 'Hydra', the Greek defense chief stressed the steady strategic cooperation of Greece, Egypt and Cyprus during the final phase of the 'Medusa-15' exercise. Emphasis was placed on modern technologies such as UAVs.

entry.title: Σαουδική Αραβία: Στις φλόγες δεξαμενή καυσίμων της Aramco κοντά στο αεροδρόμιο του Ριάντ
entry.summary: An Aramco fuel depot near Riyadh airport caught fire after explosions and air-raid warning sirens. Firefighters were battling the blaze.

entry.title: Νέα κίνητρα για άμεσες ξένες επενδύσεις
entry.summary: The government aims to introduce, for the first time, an incentives regime exclusively for foreign direct investment, including easier residence permits and guaranteed loans. Energy, tourism and real-estate management are excluded from the scheme.

entry.title: Αύξηση 110% σε 10 χρόνια στις τιμές των κατοικιών
entry.summary: House prices have risen 110% over the past decade, but the pace is slowing: +5.5% in Q2 versus 8.3% for all of 2025. The slowdown is linked to the winding down of the 'My Home 2' scheme.

entry.title: Απαγορεύτηκε η είσοδος σε δημοσιογράφους των CNN και MS NOW: Σε ισχύ η «έξωση» από τον Λευκό Οίκο
entry.summary: CNN and MS NOW journalists were denied access to the White House, a day after Donald Trump announced a ban on three outlets. The president cited displeasure over their reporting.

entry.title: CNN: Εκθεση από ΑΙ παραλίγο να οδηγήσει σε σύγκρουση ΗΠΑ-Κίνας
entry.summary: According to CNN, an AI-generated intelligence report nearly triggered a US-China clash amid the war with Iran. The US military prepared to intercept a Chinese ship allegedly carrying nuclear-related components.

entry.title: Γιατί μίλησε τώρα ο Μητσοτάκης
entry.summary: An analysis of Mitsotakis's early announcement of heating-oil subsidies frames it as recognition of the energy risk. It cites a JPMorgan report describing a deadlock in the oil market amid the Iran conflict.

entry.title: Το ντίζελ γίνεται η αχίλλειος πτέρνα του Τραμπ
entry.summary: European diesel prices hit a record $210/barrel and topped $6/gallon in the US, posing a fresh inflation risk. Diesel powers transport, shipping, farming and industry, making its rise more dangerous than gasoline's.

entry.title: «Σεμινάρια» ΑΙ στο Μαξίμου
entry.summary: Officials at the Maximos Mansion quietly attended seminars on using AI tools, run by the UAE firm Inception (part of the G42 group). The stated aim was more effective government operations and higher productivity.

entry.title: Τουρισμός: Οι αυξημένες αφίξεις και οι πίεσεις στις τιμές
entry.summary: European tourism faces a 'Great Repricing', as record revenues no longer easily convert into profit. In Greece, despite rising arrivals, average spend per trip fell, squeezing margins.

entry.title: Αχμάντ Αγουάντ μπιν Μουμπάρακ στην «Κ»: Ο λαός της Υεμένης δεν στηρίζει τη δράση των Χούθι
entry.summary: In an interview with Kathimerini, Yemen's former PM Ahmed Awad bin Mubarak argues the people do not support the Houthis. He warns their advance toward the Bab al-Mandeb strait is reshaping the strategic reality in the Red Sea.

entry.title: Δανία: Η Γροιλανδία δεν απεμπολεί την κυριαρχία της μετά τη συμφωνία με τις ΗΠΑ
entry.summary: Denmark welcomed a 'binding' deal with the US that, per Trump, grants 'permanent control' over Greenland's security and bars Russian or Chinese bases. Denmark and Greenland stress they are not surrendering sovereignty.

entry.title: Μητσοτάκης για οίκους αξιολόγησης: Οι αναβαθμίσεις επιβεβαιώνουν την ορθότητα της οικονομικής πολιτικής
entry.summary: Kyriakos Mitsotakis welcomed a double upgrade of Greece's economic outlook by Moody's and of its credit rating by Scope within 24 hours. He called them confirmation that the government's economic policy is sound and the country stable.

entry.title: Ολοκληρώθηκε η πολυεθνική διακλαδική άσκηση «Medusa 15/2026» [εικόνες – βίντεο]
entry.summary: The multinational joint exercise 'Medusa 15/2026' concluded off Crete and the Myrtoan Sea, involving Greece, Egypt, Cyprus, France and Italy. Its aim was to boost cooperation and interoperability of the armed forces.

entry.title: AfD και Μόσχα προετοιμάζουν επαφές για το ρωσικό αέριο στη Γερμανία
entry.summary: Putin's economic envoy and the far-right AfD leadership are preparing a meeting on resuming Russian gas supplies to Germany, according to Reuters. It would happen only if a Russia–Ukraine peace framework precedes it.
